email-consejos.instruction: Leé el email que Tomás le escribe a su amiga Sofía y respondé las preguntas sobre los consejos que le da.
email-consejos.text:
Hi Sofía,

Thanks for your message! I'm so happy you're coming to Bariloche next month. I have some advice for your trip.

First, you should bring warm clothes because it might be cold at night, even in spring. Also, if you want to see the lake, you have to wake up early because the tour buses leave at 7 a.m.

You don't have to bring your own ski equipment, but you should book it online before you arrive, so you don't wait in a long line.

If the weather is bad, we might go to the chocolate museum instead. It's small, but it's really fun!

See you soon,
Tomás

questions.prompt: According to Tomás, why should Sofía bring warm clothes?
options: Because she has to climb a mountain.
Because it might be cold at night, even in spring.
Because the hotel doesn't have heating.
questions.explanation: Tomás usa 'should' para dar un consejo y 'might' para expresar una posibilidad ('it might be cold'), no una certeza.

questions.prompt: What does Sofía have to do to see the lake?
options: Wake up early because the tour buses leave at 7 a.m.
questions.explanation: 'Have to' indica una obligación: Sofía necesita madrugar porque los buses salen a las 7 a.m., no es opcional.

questions.prompt: What might they do if the weather is bad?
options: They might go to the chocolate museum.
They will stay at home all day.
questions.explanation: Es una oración de primer condicional con 'might' para expresar un resultado posible, no seguro: 'If the weather is bad, we might go to the chocolate museum'.

email-consejos.instruction: Leé el email que Lucía le escribe a Martín sobre su nuevo departamento en Buenos Aires y respondé las preguntas.
email-consejos.text:
Hi Martín,

Congratulations on your new job in Buenos Aires! I know you're looking for an apartment, so here are some tips.

First, you have to bring your ID and proof of income when you visit an apartment, because landlords ask for these documents immediately. Also, you should visit the apartment in the evening, so you can check if the street is noisy.

If the rent is too high, you might find a cheaper place in Almagro or Caballito. Those neighborhoods are close to the center, but they're quieter and less expensive.

You don't have to sign a contract on the first visit, but you should decide quickly because good apartments disappear fast in this city.

If you need any help, I can go with you this weekend.

Take care,
Lucía

questions.prompt: Why does Martín have to bring his ID and proof of income?
options: Because landlords ask for these documents immediately.
Because he needs them for his new job.
questions.explanation: 'Have to' expresa una obligación impuesta por otra persona: los dueños piden esos documentos de inmediato.

questions.prompt: According to Lucía, what might happen if the rent is too high?
options: Martín might move to another city.
Martín might find a cheaper apartment in Almagro or Caballito.
Martín might have to pay more.
questions.explanation: La estructura 'If + presente, might + infinitivo' (primer condicional) muestra un resultado posible, no seguro, ante esa condición.

questions.prompt: Why should Martín decide quickly about an apartment?
options: Because the rent will increase every day.
Because good apartments disappear fast in the city.
Because he has to start work tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 'Should' se usa para dar un consejo basado en una razón lógica, en este caso, que los buenos departamentos se alquilan rápido.
